subject.title: Bug: sandbox.mode: "non-main" silently breaks sessions_spawn subagent initialization

question: Should sandboxed subagent startup failures stay inside the accepted async `sessions_spawn` contract and terminalize/log as startup failures, or should `sessions_spawn` preflight sandbox startup before returning accepted?
rationale: That choice affects the documented non-blocking spawn contract, gateway lifecycle events, session registry state, and the overlapping #58776 lifecycle design, so automation should not pick the product contract alone.

options.title: Terminalize Async Startup Failure
options.body: Keep `sessions_spawn` non-blocking and add a typed async startup-failure state with logging/session projection for Docker setup failures.

options.title: Preflight Sandbox Before Accept
options.body: Start or validate the sandbox before returning accepted, trading clearer immediate failures for a compatibility change to the spawn contract.

options.title: Defer To Lifecycle Design
options.body: Keep this issue open as the Docker proof case while #58776 settles the general lifecycle phases first.

recommendation.title: Terminalize Async Startup Failure
recommendation.body: Keep `sessions_spawn` non-blocking and add a typed async startup-failure state with logging/session projection for Docker setup failures.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history puts this owner closest to the subagent spawn, gateway admission, and sandbox context paths that need the contract decision.
